query:
SELECT a.id as acordoId, a.cobrancaId, a.status, p.id as parcelaId, p.numeroParcela, p.valor, p.dueDate, p.status as parcelaStatus
FROM acordos a 
LEFT JOIN parcelasAcordo p ON a.id = p.acordoId 
WHERE a.cobrancaId = 30001;
